title: Otto/Quotes
summary:
"Any friend of Zhalia is a friend of mine."
- Otto to the team

"I thought we were looking for snakes."
- Otto to Lok Lambert, when asked if there are poisonous spiders in the desert.

"Already I do not like this mission."
- Otto to Dante Vale

"You are guides, aren't you? Working for the Huntik Foundation until your unfortunate seperation?" (The Professor)

"We don't know this Dante Vale." (Otto)

"Odd, I don't remember mentioning his name." (The Professor)
